matchups.recap:
Rome-ans 10:9-10 ran things with a steady hand this week, letting Jaylen Warren carry the load like a Woodsman Chief on a hike with 33.8, while Jacoby Brissett chipped in 24.78 from under center. Rome Odunze and T.J. Hockenson spent the afternoon Bushwhacking without a compass, combining for under five points, but the margins were padded enough that nobody noticed. The counselor's plan absorbed the blow and came away with a well-earned Tuna Casserole regardless.

Love Thy Naber, meanwhile, is stuck on the Point and Back after a second straight losing week, and the preparation showed it. Parker Washington and Matthew Stafford both popped off at 27-plus, but CeeDee Lamb and Jaylen Waddle combined to give back nearly the whole output, stunned naval battle queens the pair of them. Down 28.16 at the final whistle, Flame On's cabin didn't get blown out so much as slowly walked on the alpine vegetation all day — not quite looked like a Woodsman playing Chief Tyler Hallenbeck in Tetherball territory, but the planning session clearly needed another look before Sunday.

Week 5's camp-wide tug of war turned into no contest at all, as The Island Gudge put together the kind of hike plan that leaves the other cabin's boots stuck in the mud. Christian Watson carried the load like a Woodsman Chief on a hike with 29.3, Joe Burrow added 24.6, and Garrett Wilson chipped in 19.9 as 46er had all the arrows in the bullseye from the opening bell. Even a quiet outing from Quinshon Judkins couldn't dent a final of 124.5 — this was a post hike scrub in every sense, and sticky buns on Sunday morning are well-earned.

Over at The Goose is Loose, counselor Stefanowits ran a week that never found its footing. Brock Bowers and Dak Prescott did their part, but TreVeyon Henderson walked on the alpine vegetation all afternoon, and the cabin as a whole had their lunch eaten by Yellow Yellow on the way to an 81.64 output that never threatened. Bushwhacking without a compass is the kind one word for it — a Beak week that leaves this camp friendship fully intact, pride mostly not.

Camp director's report this week had to account for a 51.62-point margin, and The Machine Knows earned every inch of it. Josh Allen posted 30.5, Puka Nacua carried the load like a Woodsman Chief on a hike with 29.2, and Malik Nabers chipped in 23.6, which is how you reach 137.4 even while Alvin Kamara and RJ Harvey combined for a shrug worth 2.3 points. That's a Penis Eating Pike of a roster, and whoever's still rebuilding the mess hall after this one — I want you to BRING DOWN THE ROOF, you earned it.

Ricky Huns had Aaron Rodgers doing his part at 22.0 and Kyren Williams putting in sticky-buns-worthy work, but the supporting cast was Bushwhacking without a compass all afternoon. Michael Wilson, George Kittle, and Tee Higgins combined for projections north of 35 and deliveries barely clearing 13 — this team gonna need to patch those holes with more leaves, because this cabin got soaking wet. Other Nate's camp ran out of matches before the fire ever caught.

matchups.recap:
Pill Pusher's cabin went on a Bust Hike this week, surviving its own camper named Chase Brown doing his level best to ruin the activity that bears his name. The man himself ate his trail cheese and salami for a Beak 5.5, Chris Olave walked on the alpine vegetation at 6.6, and Carnell Tate turned in a stunned naval battle queen of a showing at 1.1 points. None of that mattered because Jared Goff quietly logged a Guide Rec with 28.94, and Christian McCaffrey and Drake London carried enough of the weight to get this cabin home.

Campcraft Enthusiast meanwhile continues to prove that Team Bradford is stuck on the Point and Back, dropping a second straight activity despite Derrick Henry running like a woodsman to the camp store on his way to 20.5 and Davante Adams chipping in 19.6. Bo Nix had his lunch eaten by Yellow Yellow at the quarterback post, Harold Fannin Jr. was a full Dutch Oven at 0.9, and the whole plan was bushwhacking without a compass from the opening whistle. Sticky buns and Tuna Casserole go to the Pill Pusher cabin this week.

Catalina Wine Mixon put up 114.34 and still needed a canoeing stroke of mercy to get there, as George Pickens and Trevor Lawrence carried the load like a Woodsman Chief on a hike while half the roster sat around the fire doing nothing useful. DK Metcalf, Tre' Harris, and Jeremiyah Love combined for less than a single decent snack bar, and the Chair Force never quite adjusted to the leaks — this was a Bust Hike dressed up as a rout, Boss on the ledger but Beak in the actual experience.

55 Burgers leaned entirely on Jahmyr Gibbs galloping like a woodsman running to the camp store for 35.2, with Mike Evans chipping in a tidy 22.8, but the rest of the cabin was like living on the Point all afternoon. Cam Skattebo and KC Concepcion combined for barely a Dutch Oven's worth of production, and Counsel's plan never had an answer once the early points dried up. A tug of war decided by single digits, and this week the rope snapped their way.

Sir Jo-Nurse ran their cabin through the obstacle course like it owed them money, and Drake Maye put up 39.46 points like a woodsman running to the camp store all afternoon. Bucky Irving carried the load like a Woodsman Chief on a hike with 30.5, and Jaxon Smith-Njigba chipped in another 20.3, giving Funk that Junk a well-earned Tuna Casserole and an easy post hike scrub by 32 and change. Deebo Samuel Sr.'s 1.5 points were about the only soft spot in an otherwise Boss plan, and nobody noticed.

Blue Ridge got a Guide Rec showing from Isaiah Likely's 26.9 and Ja'Marr Chase's 16.7, but the backfield walked on the alpine vegetation all week — Tony Pollard managed 5.2 and David Montgomery turned in a Dutch Oven-adjacent 1.1 that left the whole cabin gonna need to patch those holes with more leaves. Jalen Hurts did his part at 13.0, but with the ground game stuck in the Sewards, Harley Jarvis never had a chance to find its footing. Beak week for the backfield, Boss week for Sir Jo-Nurse's compass.

headline: Week 5 brings close calls and lopsided finishes alike
